# When to Split a Page

## Question

At what size or scope should one wiki page become two?

## Why it matters

Pages that grow without bound stop being readable in thirty seconds, but splitting too early scatters one idea across many files.

## What an answer might look like

**No clear resolution path yet.** A rule based on section count was tried and ruled out; a rule based on inbound links is untested.
